text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's, and I'm relaxing in my
office when
I receive an invitation from
Yaeno Muteki to
usher in the new year
with a shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do find it a little odd that she
specifically wants
to rendezvous in a
park, but I go along with it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year! Here's to another great year!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In a moment, please! There's something
important
I have to tell you first.
choice_data_list: Then shall we go on our New Year's shrine visit?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please forgive me for what happened at
the
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I let my emotions get the best of me and
behaved
so disgracefully!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I made an embarrassing spectacle of
myself in
front of you. If there was a hole
nearby, I would
have crawled right into
it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I vow to never again repeat that blunder!
Please
accept my sincerest apologies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't especially troubled by Yaeno
Muteki's
passionate outburst after the
Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it looks like she's unable to forgive
herself for
having let her emotions
dictate her behavior.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll exercise greater restraint in the
future!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, when I said I would defeat
Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I meant it. That's my goal, and it hasn't
changed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My conduct may have been shameful,
but
everything I said came from the
heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When the crowd was going wild for
Oguri at the
Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It dawned on me that their enthusiasm
had
nothing to do with me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so caught up in the
excitement of
seeing Oguri and
Tamamo...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nobody mentioned the Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It felt as if everyone had forgotten about
the
Satsuki Sho and the Japanese
Derby... And about
Chiyono O, Ardan,
and me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I couldn't accept that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thus, I have decided to challenge Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I can best her—the racer at the center
of
everyone's attention—it will surely
make a lasting
impression and keep us
from being forgotten!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll defeat Oguri with a performance that
will live
on in the memory of the masses!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is what I have chosen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My... obsession?
choice_data_list: So that's what your 'obsession' is, huh.
So that's what your 'obsession' is, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! This fierce emotion...
this must
be obsession!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I've been suppressing these intense
emotions,
believing they must never
surface...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing this, I come to understand why
she's been
struggling to find an
obsession of her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If an obsession becomes too strong, it
can mutate
into something wild. She
must have been
disciplining herself
unconsciously to keep her
emotions in
check.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My desire to pursue this obsession
has
become so strong that I can no
longer suppress it.
choice_data_list: As long as you don't misdirect your 'obsession,' you'll be fine.
As long as you don't misdirect your 'obsession,' you'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But that's the type of passion I need if
I'm going
to make it to the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I have no choice but to dedicate
myself to
mastering the blaze fierce and
water still, to
avoid overstepping any
boundaries.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I intend to channel this obsession
towards winning
races. I will harness its
potential as I run, without
letting it take
hold of me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As per our original plan, Yaeno Muteki
and I pay
a visit to the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It seems we've avoided the crowds. Luck
is on our
side!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Have you decided what you'll be praying
for?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
For me to stay healthy? My body is
robust. I don't
think my health warrants
any concern.
choice_data_list: May your hard work bear fruit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I'm concerned she might
overdo
things by drawing on sheer
willpower to continue
even when she's
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... An uncomfortably feasible
concern.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I do believe that I know my body well,
but I'll
endeavor to be careful all the
same.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
After all, I don't wish to cause you any
undue
vexation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let's skip training today and use this
time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After visiting the shrine, Yaeno Muteki
and I head
to a teahouse to enjoy some
mochi and take it
easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Yaeno Muteki that I'm hoping for
her hard
work and commitment to
training to be rewarded.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You prayed that I be rewarded?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you are a paragon among
mentors!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must return the favor to you...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: By training! Even more training!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I best get to it! Please excuse
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I even have a chance to say that
she
should at least relax on New Year's,
she runs off.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! You want to beat Oguri Cap as
well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is that how fiercely you wish to join me
in my
goals? I read you loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's go on a boat ride!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Given the deep connection we share in
this
moment, I believe we could row a
boat in perfect
unison!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It'll be an apt opportunity to show how
in sync we
are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not fully sure what she means, but
since she
insists, I agree to go boating
with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's intuition turns out to
have been
surprisingly on the mark.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We maneuver the boat with such ease
and
perfectly synced strokes that we
end up drawing
attention from
passersby.
